name: Freedom Barkway
description: A fenced, volunteer-supported dog park tucked into Freedom Park near the Freedom Parkway trail. It has a large open field with mature shade trees and a separate small-dog area, and it is easy to reach on foot or by bike from Poncey-Highland and Inman Park.
address: Freedom Park, N Highland Ave NE & Freedom Pkwy NE, Atlanta, GA 30307
rules: Owners must remain with their dogs at all times
